name: SiteWatcher
description: Watches your websites and tells you when something goes wrong

paths.name: Data
paths.description: SiteWatcher's SQLite database with your sites, check history and settings, plus the owner password file. Back it up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: SiteWatcher dashboard and status pages, published on host as 7002

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: SITEWATCHER_WEB_ALLOWED_HOSTS
variables.description: Your server IP address, like 192.168.1.20. SiteWatcher only answers to names listed here, so replace YOUR-SERVER-IP or the page shows 400 Bad Request. Add your domain too, comma separated, if you use one.

variables.name: SITEWATCHER_ADMIN_USER
variables.description: The user name of the owner account, made on the first start.

variables.name: SITEWATCHER_ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: Leave blank and IceStore makes a password on the first start and shows it in the app's log under CREDENTIALS. Type one here to use your own; it is set again on every start.
